tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// thugs rje chen po 'khor ba las sgrol gyi gter srung gtor 'bul rgyun khyer bzhugs//

na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra ya/ zab chos 'di nyid kyi gter srung gtor 'bul mdor bsdus byed na/ zangs lcags snod du mgon po lcam dral la dmar gtor che chung gnyis/ de rgyab lha klu rgyu skar rgyal chen rnams la dkar gtor bzhi/ gza' dang 'jigs byed rnams la dmar gtor gnyis bcas phyogs bsdus su bkod cing mtheb skyus bskor/ snod gzhan du dbus su dpal lhar 'brang rgyas dkar po/ mtha' skor du shan par gru gsum ra mgos mtshan pa/ srin bshos rtser ra shas brgyan pa/ mā ra'i gru gsum snying gis brgyan pa/ gza' gtor gru gsum mig gis mtshan pa/ klu bshos dkar po sbrul dkris can/ thang lhar dkar gtor rnams bshams la bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum/ bdag nyid 'phags pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bka' srung gter srung 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: khams gsum bstan pa'i ru dra bsgral ba'i phyir: mgon po lcam dral dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba'i phyir: slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa: dpal gyi lha mo shan pa ra yi mgo: laṅka mgrin bcu mā ra snying zan dang: gza' gdong snying rkun nā ga ti pa tsa: thang lha gangs btsan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la gzhugs su gsol: spos dang me tog mar me zhal zas dang: sgra snyan gu gul dkar nag dud pas mchod: rmad du byung ba'i bdud rtsi rak+ta dang: 'dod yon longs spyod rgyan gyi gtor ma 'bul:

rgyan gyi dam rdzas mchod pa sna tshogs dang: spyan gzigs dkor cha mthun pa'i rten tu 'bul: gang dmigs bcol ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la de bī kā li de ba nā ga gra ha nak+ṣa tra bhai ra ba da sha dika ma hā rā tsa shrī nā tha e ka ha ta ri sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma hā rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti su ra go ro tsa na kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes lan gsum gyis mgon po lcam dral dpal mgon bdun cu la 'bul/ dpal lha la/ oṃ shrī de bī sarba sa ma ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: shan pa la/ oṃ muṇ+ḍa ka sa ye tshā ga sa ma ya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ= srin po la/ oṃ rak+sha rā tsa rak+sha sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ= mā ra snying zan la/ oṃ tsit+ta kha ho mā ra tri ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: gza' la/ rak+sha rā hu la pa sha mi ghi hrīṃ hrīṃ dza: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: klu la/ nā ga rā tsa nag po ti pa tsa sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ= thang lha la/ oṃ de ba tsan+t+ri nā ga tsit+ta sa ma ya hrīng hrīṃ dzaḥdza: i daṃ= zhes gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum res phul/ shrī ma hā kā la dpal 'bar dbang phyug chen po/ ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' chen brgyad/ phyogs skyong bcu/ 'jigs byed dgu /rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ rgyal chen bzhi/ 'khor g.yog sprul par bcas pa rnams dang*/ chos skyong ma gcig dpal lha/ bka' sdod shan pa ra mgo /srin po laṅka mgrin bcu/ las mkhan mā ra snying zan/ gza' gdong snying rkun nag po/ klu rgyal nā ga rak+sha/ dge bsnyen thang lha gangs btsan la sogs te dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs sogs spyi ltar phrin las bcol/ hūm̐: srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can:

tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste: grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa: dbugs dbyung khyod la bdag bstod do: dpal ldan lha mo srid gsum bdag: gdug pa'i kha rlangs dgra bgegs 'joms: rnal 'byor dam ldan bu bzhin skyong: srid gsum bdag mo khyed la bstod: lcam dral yab yum bka' nyan pa'i: lha klu gza' dang phyogs skyong dang: rgyal chen 'jigs byed rgyu skar gyi: lha mo bcas la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rnam dag mkha' dbyings bde chen nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro dpal lha mo: bdud dpung 'dul zhing dngos grub dpal: bde gter phrin las mnga' bdag mo: rigs rnams kun 'dus khyed la bstod: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang phyug stobs po che: 'dod dgur dbang sgyur thogs pa med: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun sgrub: rgyal ba'i bstan srung khyod la bstod: hūm̐: bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can: srin po'i rgyal po laṅka'i bdag: phyi nang bka' yi bya ra ba: pho nya bka' sdod bcas la bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dam tshig can: gdug pa'i ru dra ma lus sgrol mdzad pa: mā ra snying zan shugs drag rdzu 'phrul can: dbang phyug las mkhan khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong mdzad pa: rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin du: legs nyes kun gyi stangs 'dzin zhing: bstan pa srung mdzad mthu bo che: lha srin sde brgyad kun gyi gtso: 'jig rten khams kyi drag rtsal can: skye 'gro'i srog la rngams mdzad pa: gza' bdud 'khor dang bcas la bstod: hūm̐: rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa'i klong rum nas: klu yi rgyal po nā ga ti pa tsa: mthu stobs rtsal ldan sgrub mchog bu bzhin skyong: dngos grub kun 'byung khyed la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po che: yum chen sman btsun lcam gcig ma: sprul pa las mkhan 'bum sde'i tshogs: 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: gzhan yang bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i:

lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs: chos byed sgrub po skyong mdzad pa'i: mthu ldan rnams la bdag bstod do: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin du: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par spel: log lta ma lus dbang du sdus: bstan pa 'jig pa myur du sgrol: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bstod la/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā bā nāṃ/ zhes gshegs su gsol lo// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i ched du pad+ma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis gter gzhung las btus pa dge legs 'phel/// /
